title: Mentors Tower
tagline: Find a mentor in your field
summary: A platform for finding mentors in a specific area. I led the team, published the app on Google Play and supported it after launch.

caseStudy.overview: Users find mentors in a specific area and get mentorship from experienced practitioners.
contribution: Led the team building and deploying the product.
Built and published the app on the Google Play Store.
Monitored Play Console analytics after launch.
Shipped bug fixes and features based on user and client feedback.
caseStudy.approach: Ship, then iterate: after launch the team watched Play Console analytics and user feedback, and fed fixes and new features back into regular updates.
